sloka: तृतीय सवनम् चैव राज्ञोऽस्य सुमहात्मनः ।चक्रुः ते शाश्त्रतो दृष्ट्वा तथा ब्राह्मण पुंगवाः ॥१-१४-७॥
transliteration: tṛtīya savanam caiva rājño'sya sumahātmanaḥ ।cakruḥ te śāśtrato dṛṣṭvā tathā brāhmaṇa puṁgavāḥ ॥1-14-7॥

translations.english: Those exceedingly noble and eminent brahmins performed third pressing of the soma, in conformity with the sastras.
